evidence.architecture: skills-only; no MCP server, auth flow, or remote runtime

conclusion: No exact publisher-side install/user count can be asserted from currently accessible OpenAI or RUMBO surfaces. The current skills-only package has no remote execution surface from which publisher telemetry could be collected.

safe_next_measurement.native_openai_metrics: Treat as unavailable until OpenAI exposes publisher analytics or an export.
safe_next_measurement.skills_only_proxy: Optional disclosed landing-page activation; measures visits or activations, not ChatGPT accounts.
safe_next_measurement.measurable_account_usage: Requires a separately disclosed remote app/MCP component with consented authentication and privacy-safe telemetry.

integrity_rule: Never convert directory presence, a stale readiness artifact, web traffic, or local installation into a claimed account count.
